title: Stale doc comment above count_terminals names a different proc and wrong return shape
detail: Comment describes a proc 'spawned_terminals' returning node ids + kinds; the actual proc is count_terminals returning an int count of ALL live terminals, not just growth spawns.
recommended_fix: Rewrite the comment to match: 'count_terminals — live Terminal-kind node count (fixture + growth spawns); callers subtract the 2 fixture terminals.'

title: growth.dem claims last spawn at t1680, but tick 1800 (final tick) also spawns
evidence: # 88000 ms (t1760 — the settled grown map, after the last spawn at t1680).
detail: Run is 90000ms = 1800 ticks; 1800 % 120 == 0 is a spawn window. Re-sim stats show Topology.gen jumping 19→20 at tick 1800 — a 15th spawn after t1680, never captured in T2.
recommended_fix: Correct to 'after the last pre-capture spawn at t1680 (a final spawn lands at t1800, pinned by T1 only)', or shorten run to 1750ms.
